summary: Verified all 5 items in Jan-2026 bug/feature batch: duplicate-toast fix on /register, welcome-email + step-4 thank-you screen wiring, tree-plantation counter (backend endpoint + UI widget), central brand config files (frontend + backend), and admin/products endpoint. All 7 pytest cases pass and UI verification on /register, / (home) and /find-retailers is green.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnershipCTAButton.js still ships its own <Toaster position='top-center' richColors />. It is currently NOT imported anywhere (only defined), so it doesn't cause a duplicate today, but if a future page imports this component it will regress the duplicate-toast bug. Recommend removing the per-component Toaster and relying on the global one in app/layout.js.

auth.py fires send_welcome_email through both BackgroundTasks and asyncio.create_task fallback. The fallback branch (background_tasks is None) is technically unreachable via FastAPI DI but keeps the code defensive — fine, but worth a comment.
